title: DistortionReport
description: Gate G2 artifact. Blocks the valuation agent until headline earnings have been checked for non-recurring distortion. This is the single most common way a superficial multiples read goes badly wrong.

checked_items.description: Every category must appear with a verdict, even when clean. Silence is not a pass.

adjustment_walk.description: Line-by-line bridge from headline to adjusted. Reader must be able to redo the arithmetic.

fcf_note.description: If FCF is depressed by a deliberate capex cycle, say so here and require the valuation agent to model a recovery trajectory rather than extrapolating depressed FCF.

downstream_instruction.description: Explicit directive to the valuation agent, e.g. 'use eps_adjusted=6.12 for Graham and relative valuation; headline 9.40 includes a one-time stake gain.'
